title: Plasma orbs seen around the NASA space shuttle
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Plasma orbs seen around the NASA space shuttle, about Space Shuttle era (1981-2011) at Earth orbit, NASA space shuttle, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And what about the plasma orbs that people in and around the NASA space shuttle have described?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, raises the plasma orbs, glowing balls of light, that he says people in and around NASA's space shuttle have described during the shuttle years of 1981 to 2011. He asks about them as a puzzle worth explaining, since it would mean something unknown was seen in Earth orbit.
